mechanism: Deutetrabenazine may potentiate vancomycin's nephrotoxicity risk, and combined CNS effects may occur; vancomycin has minimal CYP450 interactions but deutetrabenazine undergoes hepatic metabolism.
action: Monitor renal function closely during concurrent use; assess for signs of nephrotoxicity and CNS adverse effects; ensure adequate hydration and avoid other nephrotoxic agents if possible.
